turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I'm okay, I guess. Still a bit groggy, but I can talk.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good to hear. Can you tell me your pain level out of 10? Any discomfort at the incision sites or elsewhere?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: It's about a 4 or 5. There's some soreness in the tummy area, but not too bad.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thanks. Have you felt nauseous at all since waking up? Any vomiting or dizziness?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, no nausea. I feel a bit thirsty, but nothing else.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. How's your breathing? Any shortness of breath or discomfort when taking deep breaths?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Breathing is fine. I can take deep breaths without pain.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Did you experience any awareness or discomfort during the surgery that you'd like to share?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I don’t remember anything. I was out the whole time.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. Lastly, with your diabetes and high blood pressure, have you noticed any unusual symptoms like dizziness, chest pain, or vision changes?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, nothing like that. I feel stable, just tired.
